subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed as provider-owned model/run params, through the existing compaction provider seam, or as part of the broader Anthropic context-management API design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects public config, provider routing, session replay, docs, and related Anthropic context-management requests, so automation should not choose it alone.

options.title: Provider-owned opt-in params
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while keeping OpenClaw's local/pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

options.title: Compaction provider integration
options.body: Route Anthropic native compaction through the existing compaction provider surface, accepting a broader change to that abstraction.

options.title: Broader context-management design
options.body: Keep this issue focused but wait for the broader Anthropic context-management design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041 before implementation.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned opt-in params
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while keeping OpenClaw's local/pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest prior review context plus adjacent OpenAI server-side compaction and provider/config history for this decision.
